note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. RFC 5303 Section 3.2: "The Extended Local Circuit ID field SHALL contain a value assigned by this IS when the circuit is created." b77067bc31 changed only the call sites in this unit: threeWayTLV and buildP2PHello now take a p2pNeighbor (systemID, extendedCircuitID) instead of a bare SystemID, with the zero value where none was passed before; every assertion is byte-identical and an independent judge approved the change. Verdict unchanged. Earlier judgment follows. Forbidden: an Extended Local Circuit ID field that is not the circuit's assigned value (absent, a shared constant). internal/plugins/isis/circuit/rfc5303_threeway_test.go::TestISISThreeWayExtendedLocalCircuitID: the IIH buildP2PHello emits carries HasCircuitID and LocalCircuitID == 7 (Fatalf otherwise); negative: a circuit assigned 42 emits a different value. The uint8(ifindex) uniqueness defect is RFC5303-3.2-4's {gap}.
